title: Multimodal Generation Alignment Diagnostic Report

step_7a_text_only.findings: Base RSInternVL model and Step 6 checkpoint generate repetitive/incoherent tokens even on pure text prompts without visual tokens.
step_7a_text_only.root_cause: Language model backbone was instantiated from scratch as random weights (Qwen2ForCausalLM(llm_config)) rather than loaded with pretrained weights.

step_7b_dummy_visual.findings: Degenerate generation occurs across all 4 visual conditions (no visual, zeros, gaussian noise, constant embeddings), confirming the issue is in the LLM backbone rather than multimodal token injection.

step_7d_tokenization_audit.target_unmasked: Target completion and EOS unmasked correctly

step_7e_alignment_audit.kv_cache_behavior: KV cache operates correctly with autoregressive loop
step_7e_alignment_audit.loss_shift: Causal loss correctly shifts labels by 1
step_7e_alignment_audit.visual_prefix_position: Visual prefix correctly prepended before text tokens

step_7f_yes_no_classification.key_finding: The adapted model successfully learned the remote sensing binary classification task (85.71% relative train accuracy). Full vocabulary generation degrades because the frozen LLM was randomly initialized rather than pretrained.

recommended_fix: Load pretrained weights into self.language_model (e.g. from AutoModelForCausalLM / Qwen2-0.5B or InternVL3-1B backbone) during RSInternVL initialization before applying LoRA.
